Sun.dasha_theme: visibility, recognition, dealings with authority, the father; ego and self-assertion come to the fore

Moon.dasha_theme: emotional life, home and mother, changes of residence, public dealings; fluctuating and receptive

Mars.dasha_theme: energy, competition, property, siblings; decisive action, disputes, accidents or surgery if afflicted

Mercury.dasha_theme: learning, writing, contracts, commerce, communication and networks

Jupiter.dasha_theme: growth, teaching and mentors, children, faith, expansion of resources

Venus.dasha_theme: relationships and marriage, pleasure, beauty, vehicles and luxuries, creative work

Saturn.dasha_theme: responsibility, hard work, structure, delay and endurance; slow but durable results

Rahu.dasha_theme: ambition and unconventional paths, foreign connections, sudden rises and confusions

Ketu.dasha_theme: withdrawal, spiritual interest, endings and letting go, sudden separations
